name: straumvakt
description: Straumvakt — charging operating platform. Clean V3 rebuild.

scripts.build: prisma generate && cp prisma/cf-client-package.json node_modules/straumvakt-prisma-cf-client/package.json && bash scripts/compile-cf-prisma.sh && next build --webpack
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm --prefix gateway run typecheck
scripts.deploy: prisma generate && cp prisma/cf-client-package.json node_modules/straumvakt-prisma-cf-client/package.json && bash scripts/compile-cf-prisma.sh && next build --webpack && opennextjs-cloudflare build --skipNextBuild && bash scripts/post-opennext-cf-prisma.sh && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy
scripts.deploy:staging: prisma generate && cp prisma/cf-client-package.json node_modules/straumvakt-prisma-cf-client/package.json && bash scripts/compile-cf-prisma.sh && next build --webpack && opennextjs-cloudflare build --skipNextBuild && bash scripts/post-opennext-cf-prisma.sh && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --env staging
scripts.preview: prisma generate && cp prisma/cf-client-package.json node_modules/straumvakt-prisma-cf-client/package.json && bash scripts/compile-cf-prisma.sh && next build --webpack && opennextjs-cloudflare build --skipNextBuild && bash scripts/post-opennext-cf-prisma.sh && opennextjs-cloudflare preview
scripts.preview:staging: prisma generate && cp prisma/cf-client-package.json node_modules/straumvakt-prisma-cf-client/package.json && bash scripts/compile-cf-prisma.sh && next build --webpack && opennextjs-cloudflare build --skipNextBuild && bash scripts/post-opennext-cf-prisma.sh && opennextjs-cloudflare preview --env staging
scripts.db:generate: prisma generate && cp prisma/cf-client-package.json node_modules/straumvakt-prisma-cf-client/package.json && bash scripts/compile-cf-prisma.sh && npm --prefix apps/api run prisma:generate
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check:schemas && npm run check:api-schema && npm run check:schema-parity
scripts.check:schemas: prisma validate --schema prisma/schema && prisma validate --schema apps/api/prisma/schema
